The *Paccuppannavāra* ("Present Section") is a canonical subsection within the second chapter of the *Yamaka* (the *Khandhayamaka*), located in the *Abhidhamma Piṭaka* [Catalog; SuttaCentral]. Formulated according to the characteristic paired-question method of the *Yamaka*, this section analyzes categories of existence—specifically the aggregates (*khandha*)—from the perspective of the present time period (*paccuppanna*) [Catalog; DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral records one translation in one modern language [SuttaCentral].

Computational analysis by DharmaNexus indicates extensive internal text reuse across the Abhidhamma literature, registering 97 matching passages across 14 Pali texts [DharmaNexus].
